name: CitatAI
author: bucuricageacominomarian

sections.description:
This is the official WordPress plugin of the CitatAI service, built and maintained by its operator, PARTNER ADS DIGITAL MARKETING AGENCY S.R.L. (Romania).

CitatAI (https://citatai.ro) checks how well AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude can read and cite a business website, generates the files that are missing and tracks every month whether the business appears in their answers.

This plugin is the delivery part for WordPress sites. After you connect it with a short code from your CitatAI account, it publishes on your site the materials generated there and keeps them up to date:

  • /llms.txt — a Markdown summary of the business for AI agents, served at the root of your domain. No file is written to disk; it is served from a copy stored in the database.
  • Business identity (JSON-LD) in <head> — on “Automatic” it is added only if no SEO plugin (Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework) already prints a schema, so there is no duplicate. You can also choose “Always” or “Never”.
  • Frequently asked questions — visible text plus the matching FAQPage schema, as an accordion (no JavaScript, inherits your theme’s font and colors) or as plain text. Show them at the end of the front page with one checkbox, or anywhere with the [citatai_faq] shortcode.
  • IndexNow verification file — served at /<key>.txt, so CitatAI can notify Bing and the other IndexNow search engines when your site changes.

What the plugin does not do:

  • it does not change your theme and puts no files in the WordPress installation;
  • it sends no visitor data;
  • it never asks for your WordPress password or hosting access.

If your CitatAI subscription stops, the files already published keep being served unchanged, as long as the plugin is installed. A CitatAI account is required for the plugin to have anything to publish.

The plugin interface is in English; translations are delivered through translate.wordpress.org.

External services

This plugin connects to the CitatAI service, at https://citatai.ro, operated by PARTNER ADS DIGITAL MARKETING AGENCY S.R.L. (Romania). Without it the plugin has nothing to publish. It contacts the service only after you connect it with a code from your CitatAI account.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you connect the plugin (you paste the code and click “Connect”): the connection code, your site address (home URL), the WordPress version, the PHP version and the plugin version are sent to https://citatai.ro/api/plugin/conectare. The service replies with a token for this site.
  • When the files are refreshed — twice a day through WP-Cron, when you click “Refresh files”, and when /llms.txt or the verification file is requested and the stored copy is older than 12 hours: the plugin requests the generated files from https://citatai.ro/api/plugin/fisier, sending the site token and your site address. The address is sent so the token cannot be used from another site.

No data about your visitors, users, content or orders is sent.

  • Terms and conditions: https://citatai.ro/termeni
  • Privacy policy: https://citatai.ro/confidentialitate
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search for “CitatAI”), or upload the ZIP under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, then activate it.
  2. In your CitatAI account, at step 2 (“Materials for AI assistants”), choose WordPress and click “Generate connection code”.
  3. In WordPress, open CitatAI from the left menu, paste the code and click Connect.
  4. Optional: under Settings on the same screen, choose how the business identity is added and where the frequently asked questions appear.
sections.faq:
Do I need a CitatAI account?

Yes. The plugin publishes the files generated in your CitatAI account; without an account and a connection there is nothing to publish.

Will it duplicate the schema from my SEO plugin?

Not on the default “Automatic” setting: if Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or The SEO Framework is active, the business identity is not added. If your theme prints its own business schema, choose “Never”.

How do I show the frequently asked questions?

Either check “Show them at the end of the front page” in the plugin settings (when your front page is a static page), or add a Shortcode block with [citatai_faq] on the page you want — for example a “Frequently asked questions” page linked from the menu. The questions and their FAQPage schema are printed together, once per page.

Is the content of a collapsed accordion still readable by AI assistants and search engines?

Yes. The answers are in the page HTML; the accordion only folds them visually.

What happens if I disconnect the plugin or my subscription stops?

The files already published stay on your site, unchanged, as long as the plugin is installed. Disconnecting revokes the token; the plugin simply stops receiving updates.

What happens on uninstall?

Everything the plugin stored is deleted, so /llms.txt is no longer served. Download it from your CitatAI account first if you want to keep it as a regular file.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • The frequently asked questions heading is in the language of the questions (sent by CitatAI), not in the site’s WordPress language or the plugin translation.

1.1.0

  • Published on WordPress.org; updates now come from WordPress.org.
  • English interface with a complete Romanian translation.
  • Admin notices appear only on the Dashboard and the Plugins screen, are dismissible and go away once resolved.
  • The FAQ accordion style is loaded through the WordPress style API.
  • “Refresh files” replaces “Update now”, so it is not confused with updating the plugin.

1.0.7

  • The FAQ section has its own width and margins and a sensible title size on full-width page builders.

1.0.6

  • Frequently asked questions shown as an accordion, with a “plain text” option.

1.0.4

  • Business identity on “Automatic”, without a duplicate next to SEO plugins.
  • Option to show the frequently asked questions at the end of the front page.
  • Own menu entry, a “Settings” link in the plugin list and a notice until the plugin is connected.

1.0.3

  • Serves the IndexNow verification file.
